'''Varrock Palace''' is the official residence of the ruler of [[Misthalin]] as well as the nation's primary diplomatic and military centre. Located in central [[Varrock]], it is the largest building in the city.

Since the [[Fourth Age]], Varrock Palace has been a hub of economic, political, and social development within Misthalin. The palace currently houses [[King Roald|King Roald III]] and his wife, [[Queen Ellamaria]]. As their full-time residence, it is equipped with kitchens, barracks, dining areas, a church, a large garden, troop housing areas, and other facilities. The Varrock Library is also housed here.

Amongst players, the palace is popular for its [[guard]]s, who are commonly killed for [[Combat training]] and [[pickpocket]]ed for [[Thieving training]] and profit. It also houses a [[Farming]] patch and several species of tree for [[Woodcutting]]. Its connection to [[Varrock Square]] makes it a popular route of travel. The palace also plays a large role in a number of [[quest]]s and other in-game activities.

==Features==
===Miscellaneous===
*Varrock Palace is the home of [[King Roald]].
*The palace houses the [[Varrock Palace Library]], overseen by [[Reldo]], and is involved in several [[quest]]s.
*Entry points into the [[Varrock sewers]] can be found outside the compound by the eastern entryway and in the cage in the north-east corner, only accessible through the sewers, itself.

===Skilling===
*There is a [[Tree patch]] near the palace's entrance for [[Farming]].
*In the grounds behind the palace, there are [[yew tree]]s for [[Woodcutting]].
*Once [[Garden of Tranquillity]] is completed, the [[White Tree patch|White Tree]] can be picked for [[White tree fruit]], which helps restore 5-10% [[Energy|run energy]] and 3 [[Hitpoints]] and grants 12 Farming [[experience]] each.
*There are two [[S.T.A.S.H|STASHes]] for [[Treasure Trails]] located in the compound that can be completed for [[Construction]] experience: an easy-level inconspicuous crate in the library and a master-level inconspicuous bush by the entrance of the [[Queen Ellamaria]]'s garden.
*The kitchen has two [[oven]]s that can be used for [[cooking]] and a sink to fill vessels with water.

===Combat===
*On the ground and {{FloorNumber|uk=1}}, there are [[guard]]s and [[Warrior (Thieving)|warriors]] who can be [[pickpocket]]ed or killed for [[Combat]] [[experience]].
*In the north-east corner of the compound is a cage with a [[grizzly bear]] and a ladder leading to the [[Varrock sewers]].
*On the roof there are several dummies which can be punched for [[Attack]] experience
*Behind the staircase on the ground floor, there is a [[Monk of Zamorak]] who can be used for [[Magic training|Magic]] or [[Ranged training]]
*An [[Imp]] occasionally can be found on the north side of the Palace around the Yew Trees.
*On the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}}, there is an [[altar]].

===Spawns===
*A [[body rune]] can be found by the entryway between the [[Grand Exchange]] and the palace.
*A [[pie dish]] can be found in the kitchen on the table.
*Two [[bucket]]s can be found in the eastern bedrooms on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}}.
